text: City Council, at its meeting held February 6, 7 and 8, 2024, considered Item CA12.3 , Appointment of Public Members to the Toronto Parking Authority, and appointed the following three members to the Toronto Parking Authority Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office starting February 9, 2024 and ending on February 7, 2028, and until successors are appointed: Hartley Lefton, as Chair Ruth Uy Namby Vithiananthan
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
